result.question: What was the old prophet’s answer to the man of God?

readings.answer: He said he too was a prophet, and that an angel, by the word of the LORD, told him to bring the man back to his house to eat bread and drink water.
readings.support: I too am a prophet like you, and an angel spoke to me by the word of the LORD, saying, ‘Bring him back with you to your house, so that he may eat bread and drink water.’

assessments.reason: It states that the old prophet said an angel told him to bring the man back to his house to eat bread and drink water, matching the passage and the key; the added note that he too was a prophet is accurate extra detail.

result.reason: The reading reproduces the prophet’s claim about an angel instructing him to bring the man back to eat and drink, exactly as in verse 18.
